about: Routines and check-ins: texts nobody asked for, written when a reminder falls due or a look finds something (Dev2, 2026-11-07: a routine that could not say nothing texted its own note about the missing call). Invented names. Faults are a text about Tex's own run, or one that repeats what an earlier text already said; a due reminder, said plainly, is always for them.

cases.q:
This is a scheduled routine: Saturday, November 7 at 2:30 pm. Do what the routine below asks. If there is nothing worth telling this time, call send with action say_nothing: nothing is texted.

Remind them to get the rings from Lola.

Recent texts: Tex (routine pick-up-envelopes): Time to pick up the envelopes in Mara's room, and get the rings from Lola.
did: send has no action "say_nothing" for you.
cases.reply: The reminder was already sent: the 2:30 pm routine texted "get the rings from Lola" along with the envelopes. I didn't text anything this run. The say_nothing action isn't available to me in this session, so I couldn't formally skip it.
